2b92911dc1cad928ecfc8a42d00850cf737d8722.summary: Rewterz threat alert (published 2023-12-30) reports that Microsoft again disabled the ms-appinstaller protocol handler after threat actors abused it for initial access. Signed malicious MSIX app packages, spread through Microsoft Teams or malvertising, were used by at least four financially motivated groups since November 2023 to deliver tools such as BATLOADER, FakeBat, and DarkGate, feeding ransomware operations. Named groups include Storm-0569, Storm-1113, Storm-1674, and Sangria Tempest (aka FIN7 and Carbon Spider). A separate October 2023 campaign used fake MSIX packages to deliver…
